title: Frobenius-equivariant pair extension and robust repair of eight-arcs
description: This paper studies arcs in PG(2,s^2) invariant under the quadratic Frobenius involution and the corresponding dimension-three MDS codes. Fixed mate lines turn extension by a nonfixed conjugate pair into a carrierwise counting problem, while invisible centers and collision redundancy give an exact correction. Every invariant eight-arc over every prime-power base order s >= 5 admits a fresh conjugate-pair extension; over F_25 there are at least four legal pairs, and the exceptional two-fixed-point profile has exact minimum 32. The structural reductions have human-scale Lean support, and the normalized exceptional census is checked by a separately pinned Mathlib-only certificate package.
